title: LTE: two cells on one carrier
description: Synthetic LTE FDD cells (tools/cell_gen.cpp, OFDM at 2.4 MHz, no SIBs) on 806.13 MHz, the carrier 130 kHz below the VFO centre, 4 s looped: PCI 101 (40 deg, 2 ports) and PCI 102 (200 deg, 4 dB weaker, its own timing and carrier offset). Carrier scan off. Expect talkers LTE-101 at 40 deg and LTE-102 at 200 deg.
